question: Find the area of a parallelogram, whose base is (3x − 5y + 4) m and height is (x - 5y) m.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Area of Parallelogram** = **Base** × **Height**.

Multiply (3x − 5y + 4) by (x − 5y).

⇒ 3x(x − 5y) − 5y(x − 5y) + 4(x − 5y)

⇒ 3x² − 15xy − 5xy + 25y² + 4x − 20y

⇒ 3x² + 25y² − 20xy + 4x − 20y

**∴ The correct answer is (3x² + 25y² − 20xy + 4x − 20y) m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Base (b)** = (3x − 5y + 4) m

**Height (h)** = (x − 5y) m

**Formula Used:**

**Area of a Parallelogram** = Base × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb7bad234341248f5a9d1a5d6c3762cdfde7ae1574b8dc2db92af22a6aa2abb0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (3x − 5y + 4) × (x − 5y)

⇒ Area = 3x(x − 5y) − 5y(x − 5y) + 4(x − 5y)

⇒ Area = (3x × x) − (3x × 5y) − (5y × x) + (5y × 5y) + (4 × x) − (4 × 5y)

⇒ Area = 3x² − 15xy − 5xy + 25y² + 4x − 20y

⇒ Area = 3x² + 25y² − 20xy + 4x − 20y

**∴ The correct answer is (3x² + 25y² − 20xy + 4x − 20y) m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Parallelogram

Opposite sides are equal and parallel. Opposite angles are equal, and diagonals bisect each other.

Perimeter of a Parallelogram

Perimeter = 2 × (sum of adjacent sides) = 2(a + b).

Area using Diagonals

If d₁ and d₂ are diagonals and θ is the angle between them, Area = 1/2 × d₁ × d₂ × sin(θ).</p
